newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN SAY AKRAM WILL NOT BE FIT FOR SECOND TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN SAY AKRAM WILL NOT BE FIT FOR SECOND TEST.

text.p: Pakistan captain Wasim Akram, who missed the first test after injuring his bowling arm, will also be out for the second test against Sri Lanka, Pakistan's coach Mushtaq Mohammad told Reuters on Sunday.
"Wasim Akram will not play in the second test either. We are getting Abdul Razzaq and Mohammad Hussain who will be here on Tuesday," he said.
Razzaq, a right-arm fast bowler, and left-arm spinner Hussain will be welcome additions to the Pakistan squad which has been beset by bowling problems.
They went into the first test, which began on Saturday at R. Premadasa stadium, without both opening bowlers when Waqar Younis was ruled out of the two-test tour due to a fractured left toe.
The second test is due to begin on April 26 at the SSC grounds in Colombo.
